result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that generally renders well. A few minor layout issues are present, mostly related to horizontally scrolling content being cut off at the edges.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the right edge, showing partial text and image.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontal carousels, but ensure adequate visual affordance (peek or arrow) indicates scrollability and that text truncation is intentional with ellipsis.

issues.description: The category filter chips row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears cut off on the right, suggesting more items scroll horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek of the next chip or a fade/gradient edge to indicate more categories are available via scrolling.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the ramen card is white/outlined on a dark image, while on the pizza card it appears in a dark circular background, creating inconsistent styling.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon treatment across all cards for visual consistency.
